query_ground_truth.workflow_task: As part of our annual CRM and marketing cleanup, we need to retire obsolete data across platforms. First, I need to look up all the LinkedIn company pages and organizations where my account holds administrative roles so we know which brand spaces are active. Then, I need to clean out several outdated products from our product catalog and remove a batch of old promotional email records that are no longer needed for compliance archiving.
query_ground_truth.query: Clean up historical marketing data by archiving multiple old marketing emails using their unique HubSpot IDs.
query_ground_truth.rationale: Executes the bulk archival of specific HubSpot email records as requested in the cleanup workflow.
